response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_flow, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, net_flow, num_transactions, CAST(net_flow AS REAL) / SUM(net_flow) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM per_account ORDER BY share_of_total DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The number of transactions counts all of the account's transactions that match an account and district, including types other than PRIJEM and VYDAJ (such as VYBER). Only the net flow sum excludes those types.
The total net flow is summed over all accounts that have a matching account and district record. The share is computed over that set before the top 10 cut, and it uses real (non-integer) division.

alternatives.interpretation: The number of transactions counts only PRIJEM and VYDAJ transactions, so it matches the rows used in the net flow.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS net_flow, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, net_flow, num_transactions, CAST(net_flow AS REAL) / SUM(net_flow) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM per_account ORDER BY share_of_total DESC LIMIT 10
